Zainab Hai Mera Naam Lyrics In Punjabi
Khaybar Shikan Di Dhi Aan Zainab Hai Mera Naam.
Wekhan Gay Loag Sare Fatha Karan Gi Sham.
Main Fatima Di Dhi Aan Mera Nana Mustafa Aye.
Molood-e-Kaba Jehra Mera Baba Murtaza Aye.
Jibreel Jaye Malaik Ais Dar De Ne Ghulam.
Chan Veer Aakhday Ne Jehray Loag Tainu Bagi.
Sabit Karan Gi Aj Main Mera Veer Hai Namazi.
Aakhan Gay Loag Sare Haq Da Ayein Tu Imam.
Babay De Naal Khul Ke Jis Gal Kaday Na Keeti.
Sharam-o-Haya Di Malka De Naal Jehri Beeti.
Fasiq De Naal Jis Dam Karni Payi Kalam.
Sir Te Rida-e-Parcham Wich Sham Mere Honri.
Aawaz V Be Pardah Nayi Veer Meri Honri.
Babay Ali De Lehjay Wich Karna Main Kalam.
Zamin Meri Rida Da Shair-e-Khuda Da Shair Aye.
Babay Ali De Wangoon Abbas Veer Mere.
Jag Nu Sikhaya Mera Ghazi Ne Ayhteram.
Ho Ke Aseer Karna Bazar Main Uboor Aye.
Meri Bekasi Te Ronra Akhiyaan Choon Rat Ghayoor Aye.
Sir Nangay Dhi Ali Di Har Pasay Balwa Aam.
Qasar-e-Yazidiyat Di Hil Wesi Har Dewar Aye.
Ban Wesi Mera Lehja Haider Di Zulfiqar Aye.
Fasiq De Naal Honra Jis Welay Hum Kalam.
Veran De Naal Kita Wadah Aye Main Nibharan.
Ja Ja Te Sadmay Seh Ke Rang Deen Choon Main Lanra.
Islam Di Baqa Te Honra Safar Tamam.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 26 verses in Shahmukhi, preserving the original order and stanza numbering. Moved the Roman wording to `romanLyrics`, removed decorative verse-end periods, updated the titles and script metadata, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag. All 26 verse pairs match in order and count.

I read the ambiguous Roman phrases “Rat Ghayoor” as `رت غیور` and “Nibharan” as `نبھاراں`.
